name: malicious-systemd-service
description: Practice-box persistence finding: installs and enables a harmless training systemd unit that invokes the hidden cocoa sync payload.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cat > /etc/systemd/system/cocoa-update.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Cocoa update helper (training finding)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/opt/.cocoa/cocoa-sync
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/cocoa-update.service
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    systemctl daemon-reload
    systemctl enable --now cocoa-update.service
fi
